chrome_hint: eBay AU sold + Terapeak: 'sterling silver thimble lot', 'job lot silver thimbles', 'Charles Horner thimble Chester', 'antique silver thimbles collection 30'. Also eBay AU sold 'silver thimbles Birmingham hallmarked' (note per-thimble price, usually $15-40 each). Check Leski, Noble and Mossgreen/Lawsons realised prices for 'silver thimbles'. Compare scrap: count of sterling thimbles x ~3-6g each.
viewing_check: Count how many thimbles are actually hallmarked silver vs base metal; photograph and read the hallmarks (Chester/Birmingham, date letter, maker: Charles Horner, Henry Griffith, James Fenton etc.); look for any gold, enamel, stone-top, named-maker or Australian-made thimble; note dents or worn tops; weigh if allowed.
